{{Top|leg}}
A '''hull cutter''' was a type of tool used for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] maintenance. While attempting to fight the [[Doom Slayer]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] at [[Drop Point: Gelgelar]], [[Ivhin Jayme]] used a pair of hull cutters as a makeshift weapon. The weight of the tool and his own strength allowed him to inflict serious damage on the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Armor/Legends|armored]] body.<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
